offerings.name: Search
offerings.pricing: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results. Hobby: $16/month billed yearly for 5,000 credits/month; 1,000 extra credits per $5.
offerings.free_quota: Free Plan: 1,000 credits / month; 500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped.
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果（web、news、images），含标题、描述和 URL；可选抓取完整页面内容。
offerings.note: 搜索结果默认含 query-relevant Highlights；1–10 结果收费 2 credits，按每 10 条向上取整。
